item.title: Maine Democrat criticized for backing popular vote after winning Senate nomination without it
item.description: Troy Jackson won 75% of delegate votes at Maine's convention, but critics argue the process contradicts his support for popular vote democracy.

item.title: Former stenographer tells Newsmax Biden violated law on classified documents
item.description: Mike McCormick, a former White House stenographer, told Newsmax that Joe Biden broke the law by keeping and sharing classified material as vice president.

item.title: Kentucky governor urges McConnell to prove fitness or resign: 'Address the people'
item.description: Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear called on Sen. Mitch McConnell to demonstrate his fitness for office or step down after the 84-year-old's extended hospital stay.
